figurative_meaning_en: To become the object of ridicule by the general public
similar_in_english: To be the butt of jokes
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার অদ্ভুত আচরণের জন্য সে লোক হাসানো হয়েছে।
ভুল সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়ায় কোম্পানিটি লোক হাসানো হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: Due to his bizarre behavior, he became a laughingstock among people.
The company became the butt of jokes after making the wrong decision.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali social norms around public perception and shame.
